The deed gives the friend a fee simple subject to an executory limitation, with a shifting executory interest in the sister’s children who reach 25. Because the class is open and contingent, the Rule Against Perpetuities applies, but any child born during the sister’s lifetime will reach 25, if at all, within 21 years of her death, so the class is valid as to all such children. Title is therefore in the friend, the son, the daughter, and any additional children of the sister born during her lifetime.
CONFIDENCE: 95
